text: タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ないけどな

structure.jp: タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ないけどな
structure.en: not as much as Takeshi, though

patterns.name: 〜ほどじゃない
patterns.span: タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ない
patterns.explanation: ほど means 'to the level of', so ほどじゃない says something does not reach that level. タケシさん　ほどじゃ　ない = 'not as good as Takeshi'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど at the end of a sentence adds a trailing 'though', softening what was said before. ないけど = 'it isn't, though'.
